package onboardingpathexecution

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/courseplan"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Processor struct {
	Enabled     bool
	Executions  repository.OnboardingPathExecutionRepository
	Graphs      repository.ReadinessGoalGraphRepository
	Policies    repository.PolicyRepository
	Readiness   domainservice.StudentPlanningReadinessService
	Students    domainservice.OnboardingPathExecutionStudentService
	Courses     domainservice.CourseService
	Generator   domainservice.ContentGenerator
	IDs         courseplan.IDGenerator
	Clock       courseplan.Clock
	Strategies  pedagogy.Registry
	LeaseTTL    time.Duration
	MaxAttempts int
}
type Worker struct {
	Processor    Processor
	PollInterval time.Duration
	Logger       *slog.Logger
}

func (w Worker) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	interval := w.PollInterval
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = 2 * time.Second
	}
	logger := w.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		processed, err := w.Processor.ProcessNext(ctx)
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "onboarding path execution failed", "error", err)
		}
		if processed {
			continue
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func (p Processor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if !p.Enabled {
		return false, nil
	}
	if p.Executions == nil || p.Graphs == nil || p.Policies == nil || p.Readiness == nil || p.Students == nil || p.Courses == nil || p.Generator == nil || p.IDs == nil || p.Clock == nil || p.LeaseTTL <= 0 || p.MaxAttempts < 1 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := p.Clock.Now().UTC()
	handoff, err := p.Executions.NextAcceptedHandoff(ctx)
	var execution domain.OnboardingPathExecution
	if err == nil {
		execution, err = domain.NewOnboardingPathExecution(handoff, now)
		if err == nil {
			execution, _, err = p.Executions.CreateOrGetOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, execution)
		}
	} else if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		execution, err = p.Executions.NextOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, now)
	} else {
		return false, err
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	claimed, err := p.Executions.ClaimOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, execution.ExecutionID, p.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(p.LeaseTTL))
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		execution, err = p.Executions.NextOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, now)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return false, nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return true, err
		}
		claimed, err = p.Executions.ClaimOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, execution.ExecutionID, p.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(p.LeaseTTL))
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return false, nil
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	return true, p.processClaimed(ctx, claimed)
}

func (p Processor) processClaimed(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution) error {
	if len(e.Snapshot) == 0 {
		return p.reserveAndFreeze(ctx, e)
	}
	frozen, err := DecodeFrozenSnapshot(e.Snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "SNAPSHOT_INVALID", err)
	}
	canonicalSnapshot, err := json.Marshal(frozen)
	if err != nil || e.SnapshotHash == "" || sha256Hex(canonicalSnapshot) != e.SnapshotHash {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	// A durable materialization command is replayed verbatim after a lost ACK.
	// It must not be preceded by another renewal, which would change its fence.
	if e.CourseID != "" && e.StudentCommandHash != "" {
		return p.materialize(ctx, e, frozen, e.CourseLessons, false)
	}
	if err := p.renew(ctx, &e); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(e.GeneratedCourse) == 0 {
		course, err := p.generateCheckpointedCourse(ctx, &e, frozen)
		if err != nil {
			return p.retry(ctx, e, "CONTENT_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		payload, err := json.Marshal(course)
		if err != nil || len(payload) > domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes {
			return p.retry(ctx, e, "GENERATED_DRAFT_INVALID", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		hash := sha256Hex(payload)
		if err := p.Executions.CheckpointOnboardingCourse(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, payload, hash, p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		e.GeneratedCourse, e.GeneratedCourseHash = payload, hash
	}
	var course domain.GeneratedCourse
	if json.Unmarshal(e.GeneratedCourse, &course) != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "GENERATED_DRAFT_INVALID", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	canonicalCourse, marshalErr := json.Marshal(course)
	if marshalErr != nil || e.GeneratedCourseHash == "" || sha256Hex(canonicalCourse) != e.GeneratedCourseHash || course.Fingerprint != frozen.Course.Fingerprint {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "GENERATED_DRAFT_INVALID", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if e.CourseID == "" {
		if err := p.renew(ctx, &e); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		courseKey := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("course-onboarding-path-ensure:"+e.ExecutionID)).String()
		result, err := p.Courses.EnsureCourse(ctx, course, courseKey)
		if err != nil {
			return p.retry(ctx, e, "COURSE_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if result.CourseID == "" || len(result.Lessons) == 0 {
			return p.retry(ctx, e, "COURSE_INVALID_RESPONSE", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		if err := p.Executions.CheckpointOnboardingCourseReceipt(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, result.CourseID, result.Reused, result.Lessons, p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		e.CourseID, e.CourseReused, e.CourseLessons = result.CourseID, result.Reused, result.Lessons
		// The exact Course-owned bindings are needed for Student's atomic command.
		return p.materialize(ctx, e, frozen, result.Lessons, true)
	}
	// A crash after the Course receipt has no local copy of Course bindings.
	// Re-ensuring with the same deterministic command is the only permitted way
	// to obtain the exact idempotent receipt; it never regenerates content.
	return p.materialize(ctx, e, frozen, e.CourseLessons, true)
}

func (p Processor) generateCheckpointedCourse(ctx context.Context, e *domain.OnboardingPathExecution, frozen FrozenSnapshot) (domain.GeneratedCourse, error) {
	contents, err := p.Executions.ListOnboardingPathLessonContent(ctx, e.ExecutionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
	}
	byIndex := make(map[int]domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent, len(contents))
	for _, content := range contents {
		var generated domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent
		if content.ExecutionID != e.ExecutionID || content.LessonIndex < 0 || content.ContentHash == "" || json.Unmarshal(content.Content, &generated) != nil {
			return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		canonicalContent, marshalErr := json.Marshal(generated)
		if marshalErr != nil || sha256Hex(canonicalContent) != content.ContentHash {
			return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := byIndex[content.LessonIndex]; duplicate {
			return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		byIndex[content.LessonIndex] = content
	}
	course := frozen.Course
	index := 0
	for mi := range course.Modules {
		for si := range course.Modules[mi].Sections {
			for li := range course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Lessons {
				lesson := &course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Lessons[li]
				key := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(e.ExecutionID+"\x00"+course.Fingerprint+"\x00"+course.Modules[mi].Code+"\x00"+course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Code+"\x00"+lesson.Code)).String()
				content, exists := byIndex[index]
				var generated domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent
				if exists {
					if content.ModuleCode != course.Modules[mi].Code || content.SectionCode != course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Code || content.LessonCode != lesson.Code || content.AIIdempotencyKey != key || json.Unmarshal(content.Content, &generated) != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
					}
				} else {
					if err := p.renew(ctx, e); err != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
					}
					generated, err = p.Generator.GenerateLesson(ctx, domainservice.LessonGenerationInput{CourseContext: frozen.Authoring.CourseContext(), Lesson: *lesson, Language: course.Language}, key)
					if err != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
					}
					if err := courseplan.NormalizeGeneratedLessonContent(&generated); err != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
					}
					raw, marshalErr := json.Marshal(generated)
					if marshalErr != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, marshalErr
					}
					content = domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent{ExecutionID: e.ExecutionID, LessonIndex: index, ModuleCode: course.Modules[mi].Code, SectionCode: course.Modules[mi].Sections[si].Code, LessonCode: lesson.Code, AIIdempotencyKey: key, Content: raw, ContentHash: sha256Hex(raw), CreatedAt: p.Clock.Now().UTC()}
					if err := p.Executions.CheckpointOnboardingPathLessonContent(ctx, *e, e.ClaimToken, content); err != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
					}
				}
				if err := courseplan.NormalizeGeneratedLessonContent(&generated); err != nil {
					return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
				}
				lesson.DescriptionMarkdown, lesson.Examples, lesson.Tasks, lesson.Status = generated.DescriptionMarkdown, generated.Examples, generated.KnowledgeChecks, domain.LessonStatusActive
				index++
			}
		}
	}
	if len(contents) > index {
		return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	course.Status = domain.CourseStatusActive
	return course, nil
}

func (p Processor) reserveAndFreeze(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution) error {
	snapshot, err := p.Readiness.GetPlanningReadiness(ctx, e.Handoff.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "STUDENT_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	snapshot, err = domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil || snapshot.StudentID != e.Handoff.StudentID {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "STUDENT_SNAPSHOT_INVALID", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if snapshot.ActivePath != nil {
		return p.complete(ctx, e, domain.OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists)
	}
	if snapshot.StateRef != e.Handoff.StateRef {
		return p.complete(ctx, e, domain.OnboardingExecutionStateChanged)
	}
	admission, err := p.Students.ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.Handoff, e.ExecutionID, e.ReserveKey)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrActivePathExists) {
		return p.complete(ctx, e, domain.OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists)
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged) {
		return p.complete(ctx, e, domain.OnboardingExecutionStateChanged)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	graph, err := p.Graphs.GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(ctx, e.Handoff.Goal.Code, e.Handoff.Goal.Version, e.Handoff.Goal.GraphVersion)
	if err != nil {
		return p.abortAndRetry(ctx, e, admission, "CANCELLED", "GOAL_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	policy, err := p.Policies.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return p.abortAndRetry(ctx, e, admission, "CANCELLED", "POLICY_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	frozen, hash, err := BuildFrozenSnapshot(graph, policy, snapshot, p.Strategies)
	if err != nil {
		return p.abortAndRetry(ctx, e, admission, "CANCELLED", "SNAPSHOT_INVALID", err)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(frozen)
	if err != nil {
		return p.abortAndRetry(ctx, e, admission, "CANCELLED", "SNAPSHOT_INVALID", err)
	}
	if err := p.Executions.CheckpointOnboardingSnapshot(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, payload, hash, admission.AdmissionID, admission.Fence, admission.ExpiresAt, p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (p Processor) materialize(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution, frozen FrozenSnapshot, lessons []domain.CourseLessonBinding, renew bool) error {
	if len(lessons) == 0 || e.AdmissionID == "" || e.AdmissionFence < 1 {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "COURSE_RECEIPT_INVALID", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if renew {
		if err := p.renew(ctx, &e); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	command := domainservice.OnboardingPathMaterialization{StudentID: e.Handoff.StudentID, AdmissionID: e.AdmissionID, ExecutionID: e.ExecutionID, Fence: e.AdmissionFence, CourseID: e.CourseID, CourseFingerprint: frozen.Course.Fingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: frozen.Course.PlannerVersion, ReasonCode: "initial_onboarding", ReasonSummary: "Accepted onboarding path", Lessons: lessons, IdempotencyKey: e.StudentCommandID}
	if e.StudentCommandHash == "" {
		payload, marshalErr := json.Marshal(command)
		if marshalErr != nil {
			return p.retry(ctx, e, "MATERIALIZATION_INVALID", marshalErr)
		}
		if err := p.Executions.CheckpointOnboardingMaterialization(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, sha256Hex(payload), p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		e.StudentCommandHash = sha256Hex(payload)
	}
	result, err := p.Students.MaterializeOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, command)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrActivePathExists) {
		return p.abortThenComplete(ctx, e, "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS", domain.OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists)
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged) {
		return p.abortThenComplete(ctx, e, "STATE_CHANGED", domain.OnboardingExecutionStateChanged)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "MATERIALIZATION_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	e.Status, e.LearningPathID, e.FirstLessonID = domain.OnboardingExecutionPathReady, result.LearningPathID, result.FirstLessonID
	return p.complete(ctx, e, e.Status)
}

func (p Processor) renew(ctx context.Context, e *domain.OnboardingPathExecution) error {
	if e.AdmissionID == "" || e.AdmissionFence < 1 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	key := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(e.ExecutionID, "renew", e.AdmissionFence)
	admission, err := p.Students.RenewOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.Handoff, e.AdmissionID, e.AdmissionFence, e.ExecutionID, key)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrActivePathExists) {
		if terminalErr := p.abortThenComplete(ctx, *e, "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS", domain.OnboardingExecutionActivePathExists); terminalErr != nil {
			return terminalErr
		}
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStateChanged) {
		if terminalErr := p.abortThenComplete(ctx, *e, "STATE_CHANGED", domain.OnboardingExecutionStateChanged); terminalErr != nil {
			return terminalErr
		}
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now := p.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if err := p.Executions.RenewOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.ExecutionID, e.ClaimToken, admission.Fence, admission.ExpiresAt, now, now.Add(p.LeaseTTL)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	e.AdmissionFence, e.AdmissionExpiresAt = admission.Fence, &admission.ExpiresAt
	return nil
}
func (p Processor) abortThenComplete(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution, reason, status string) error {
	key := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(e.ExecutionID, "abort:"+reason, e.AdmissionFence)
	if err := p.Students.AbortOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.Handoff, e.AdmissionID, e.AdmissionFence, e.ExecutionID, reason, key); err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "ABORT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	return p.complete(ctx, e, status)
}
func (p Processor) abortAndRetry(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution, admission domainservice.OnboardingPathAdmission, reason, code string, cause error) error {
	key := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(e.ExecutionID, "abort:"+reason, admission.Fence)
	if err := p.Students.AbortOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.Handoff, admission.AdmissionID, admission.Fence, e.ExecutionID, reason, key); err != nil {
		return p.retry(ctx, e, "ABORT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	e.Status, e.FailureCode = domain.OnboardingExecutionFailed, code
	if completeErr := p.Executions.CompleteOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, p.Clock.Now().UTC()); completeErr != nil {
		return errors.Join(cause, completeErr)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", code, cause)
}
func (p Processor) complete(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution, status string) error {
	e.Status = status
	return p.Executions.CompleteOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, p.Clock.Now().UTC())
}
func (p Processor) retry(ctx context.Context, e domain.OnboardingPathExecution, code string, cause error) error {
	now := p.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if e.Attempts >= p.MaxAttempts {
		e.Status, e.FailureCode = domain.OnboardingExecutionFailed, code
		if e.AdmissionID != "" && e.AdmissionFence >= 1 {
			key := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(e.ExecutionID, "abort:CANCELLED", e.AdmissionFence)
			if abortErr := p.Students.AbortOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e.Handoff, e.AdmissionID, e.AdmissionFence, e.ExecutionID, "CANCELLED", key); abortErr != nil {
				return errors.Join(cause, abortErr)
			}
		}
		if err := p.Executions.CompleteOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, now); err != nil {
			return errors.Join(cause, err)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", code, cause)
	}
	delay := time.Duration(e.Attempts*e.Attempts) * time.Second
	if delay > time.Minute {
		delay = time.Minute
	}
	if err := p.Executions.RetryOnboardingPathExecution(ctx, e, e.ClaimToken, code, now, now.Add(delay)); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(cause, err)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", code, cause)
}
func sha256Hex(raw []byte) string    { d := sha256.Sum256(raw); return hex.EncodeToString(d[:]) }
func mustJSON(v any) json.RawMessage { raw, _ := json.Marshal(v); return raw }
